subject: general
question: Which Indian state hosted the International Millet Conference, 2025, to promote millet farming and trade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Karnataka hosted the **International Millet Conference in 2025** to promote millet farming and trade, aiming to boost awareness regarding the nutritional and ecological benefits of millets.
 
• The state is one of the largest producers of millets in India, with crops like ragi (finger millet), jowar (sorghum), and bajra (pearl millet) widely cultivated.
 
• Karnataka has been at the forefront of millet promotion, with initiatives like the “**Raitha Siri**” scheme that provides financial incentives for millet farmers.
 
• The conference brought together national and international stakeholders, including policymakers, researchers, and farmers, to discuss innovations and strategies for enhancing millet production and global trade.
 
• The event aligned with India’s efforts to celebrate 2023 as the **International Year of Millets**, as declared by the United Nations, emphasizing sustainable agricultural practices and food security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Millets**

 
 
• Millets are highly nutritious, drought-resistant crops that require less water and chemical inputs, making them ideal for sustainable agriculture.
 
• Commonly referred to as “**nutri-cereals**,” they are rich in protein, fiber, vitamins, and minerals, contributing to food and nutritional security.
 
• Promoting millet cultivation aligns with global goals like combating climate change and ensuring food security for marginalized communities.
